18 lines: the defaulted constructor and destructor.
119 lines: the line grammar (45-61), getPosition and getParam.
58 lines: getIndex and the unchecked 4-byte getIntensity read.
The class test, 80 lines, 4 START_SECTIONs, all ported into tests/xmass_file.rs.

external_reference_note: The F5 oracle driver, its build-and-run script and its case generator live outside this repository under ../oracle/F5-xmass/ so that no C++ is committed here. It was built on ibminode06 against the Linux x86_64 Release install /ceph/ibmi/abi/oliver/opt/openms4-release-bc9cc12-c19e494-174b576 (libOpenMS.so sha256 abd4fc9977823c793b4396586210a867cf72482cd3ab228d6aec8ddb54966d6c) with x86_64-conda-linux-gnu-g++ 14.4.0 and libOpenMS's core flags, and every case was run twice in fresh processes with identical output. Recorded, not re-verified by the in-repo gate.
evidence: Tier 1 for load (every peak bit-identical to the executed Release build); tier 3 for the class-test expectation file and metadata; tier 4 for the native bounds.
gaps: The spectrum comment 'no comment' that load sets is not reproduced: the kernel MSSpectrum has no comment field (SpectrumSettings::comment), a kernel gap outside this group.
